note: The Nightvault app list (source). build_catalog.py turns this into apps.json with version and size per app. Paths are relative to the site root.

apps.name: The Nightvault
apps.desc: The home screen with the app tiles, installing and updates

apps.name: Scanner
apps.desc: The full app: scan cards, binders, my cards, decks, prices
apps.keepsData: Your collection stays: Scanner and Binder share it.

apps.name: Binder
apps.desc: Only your binders - the same collection as Scanner, no scanning
apps.keepsData: Your collection stays: Scanner and Binder share it.

apps.name: Convert
apps.desc: Many pictures to WebP and AVIF at once

apps.name: Control
apps.desc: Data jobs and your data sets

apps.name: GO
apps.desc: Keep or transfer advice for Pokémon GO

apps.name: Bookcase
apps.desc: Comics, manga, books and rulebooks on shelves, with one reader
apps.keepsData: Your books, reading places, bookmarks and groups stay on this device. Books in phone folders are never deleted.

apps.name: Music
apps.desc: Your music with big covers, albums and playlists
apps.keepsData: Your songs, favourites, play counts and playlists stay on this device.

apps.name: Audiobooks
apps.desc: Audiobooks that remember where you were, at any speed
apps.keepsData: Your audiobooks and where you were stay on this device.

apps.name: Cinema
apps.desc: Movies, TV shows, cartoons and anime, each on its own shelf, with one video player (phone, PC or saved for a trip)
apps.keepsData: Your list, what you watched, groups and TMDB key stay on this device. Video files are never deleted.

apps.name: Boardgames
apps.desc: Your board games with BoardGameGeek sync, miniatures and terrain
apps.keepsData: Your plays, games added by hand, pictures and groups stay on this device. Games from BoardGameGeek come back by themselves.

apps.name: 3D Print
apps.desc: Your 3D models (STL, OBJ, 3MF) with a 3D viewer, projects and your print log
apps.keepsData: Your models list, prints, tags, groups and copies in the app stay on this device. Files in phone folders are never deleted.

apps.name: Collectables
apps.desc: Everything else you collect, in your own groups

apps.name: Games
apps.desc: Your computer, console, retro and handheld games, and your wishlist
apps.keepsData: Your games, copies, wishlist, groups and keys stay on this device.
